# Symbol, Account, and Trust — Marks That Circulate

A tally makes a cut and preserves it as a mark. A symbolon is broken so that the break can later attest a relation. An account orders marks into a telling. Credit advances trust. A record returns an event to the heart of a community that must remember it. These are not one word-family, and the cluster does not need them to be. Their resonance concerns the life of a mark that travels beyond its first situation while remaining answerable to what gave it standing.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Readiness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Greek *sym-ballein* / *symbolon* | Throwing or bringing together; a token whose separated pieces can be matched. | **Attested semantic field.** The broken token becomes an exact material figure for seam-retaining relation. | Existing project sources and [§2 · #2](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) provide the current argument route; recover a primary lexical witness for historical exposition. |
| Greek *dia-ballein* | Throwing across/apart; later conflict, accusation, and division belong to its semantic history. | **Attested semantic field.** The verb gives an historical body to separating operations. | Verify chronological senses before public philology. |
| Latin *computare* / account | *Computare* joins counting with calculation; the later account-field also names a rendering or telling. | **Semantic development / operational homology.** A ledger and a narrative both make events answerable through an ordered sequence of marks. | The “cut together” rendering is a lexical lead, not yet a public claim. |
| reckon / rule / right | The Germanic reckon-field is commonly connected to directing, straightening, or ruling. | **Lexical lead.** Reckoning may give a scattered set a line, rule, or measure; the root-chain needs a specialist dictionary before use. | Do not use the connection as evidence until it is verified. |
| *credit* / *record* | *Credere* belongs to the trust/belief field; *recordari* is remembering through the heart (*cor*). | **Philological descent, pending lexical confirmation.** Credit advances a claim on trust; record makes a past act return to collective memory. | Acquire Latin dictionary and legal-history witnesses. |
| coin / coinage / claim / fiat / value | Coining is striking a marked token; a claim is publicly voiced; *fiat* is “let it be made”; *value* reaches English through Latin *valere*, strength or worth. | **Mixed semantic field.** The relation among coined word, token, decree, claim, and worth is operational, not a single descent. | Verify individual English and Latin paths before historical use. |
| tally / score / digit | Bodily and material counting practices connect marks, fingers, notches, and totals. | **Material-historical lead.** | Do not make a PIE root claim for *digitus* or a universal origin story without specialised sources. |

## The account as a relation that must return

To give an account is already more than to possess information. The account arranges a sequence, makes a claim about what happened, and offers that claim to another who can accept, correct, or refuse it. The financial ledger and the narrative account therefore meet in a project-level operational homology: both stabilise a field of relations by marks that can circulate and be reviewed. Their distinct histories remain distinct.

This is why the cluster belongs beside trust. A credit relation does not eliminate risk; it stages risk by making a future return claimable. A record does not resurrect what happened; it carries a revisable trace into a later present. The architectural consequence is direct: provenance, source, memory, review, and contestability form the minimum body of an account that does not mistake legibility for possession. They are the system's way of keeping a mark from quietly occupying the zero.

The operation is strongest where it meets the historical *symbolon*. The mark survives separation because it bears a shape through which a counterpart can be recognised. A ledger can become a dead inventory when it forgets the relations that made its entries meaningful; a symbol becomes a fetish when it forgets the fracture and the other half. In both cases sym-ballein asks whether the trace still carries provenance, reciprocal address, and a route of return.

## Comparative lenses held as leads

The initial intake opens several non-cognate cultural lines whose semantic knots deserve dedicated sources before they are used substantively:

| Field | Lead | Relation at present |
|---|---|---|
| Sanskrit *Sāṃkhya* | A philosophical school whose name is associated with enumeration or counting. | A possible historical neighbour for philosophical counting; no project inference follows until a source is recovered. |
| Hebrew S-P-R | Count, book, scribe, and number reportedly share a root field. | A promising count / write / tell braid; requires Hebrew lexicon and primary textual context. |
| Chinese *zhengming* | The rectification of names connects social order to the fittingness of names and roles. | A political resonance with constitutive naming, not evidence of a shared linguistic origin. |
| Arabic *ḥisāb* and the Names | Reckoning and the counted recitation of divine names open an accounting/devotional field. | Requires Arabic sources and theological context; currently a research lead. |
| Egyptian *rn* | The name is reported as a load-bearing component of continued personhood. | A historical-religious lead requiring Egyptological sources; no cross-cultural claim is yet made. |

These are not decorative world examples. Each could alter the essay's account of naming, record, or value, but only after its own terms have been recovered and allowed to resist the cluster's desired pattern.

| Needed evidence | First research address | Why it is needed |
|---|---|---|
| *symbolon*, *sym-ballein*, *dia-ballein* | LSJ; primary Greek usage; existing symbolon source route | Stabilise the lexical history under the essay's existing derived operation. |

| Trust and remembrance | Latin dictionaries for *credere* and *recordari*; legal history of credit | Test the heart/trust etymology and distinguish it from the project's philosophical account of trust. |
| Cross-cultural leads | Specialist lexica and primary editions in the relevant language | Keep a meaningful resonance from becoming an ungrounded synthesis. |

## Argument routes

| Route | Work performed by the cluster |
|---|---|
| [§2 · #1 — Dia-Ballein](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/20-s2-p1-dia-ballein.md) | A count or classification can render a field governable while concealing the exclusions and relations that make its terms possible. |
| [§2 · #2 — Sym-Ballein](../../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/21-s2-p2-sym-ballein.md) | The symbolon supplies the material test: a mark must retain separation, provenance, and the possibility of reciprocal recognition. |
| [Trust, Faith, and the Formal Limit](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/18-trust-faith-formal-limit.md) | Credit and record sharpen the difference between a living relation of trust and the documents that can only make its conditions inspectable. |
| [§5 · #3 — Preference Models and the Hidden Zero](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) | Scores, baselines, and records become an account of value whose excluded conditions must remain contestable. |
| [§5→0 · #1 — QL, MEF, Bimba, and Harness](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/44-s50-p1-ql-mef-bimba-harness.md) | Provenance and revision give the abstract account a technical body without confusing its audit trail with the relation itself. |
| [Language, Symbol, and Dialogue](../../histories/language-symbol-dialogue/HISTORY.md) | Connects symbol, signification, and shared meaning to the existing historical route. |

The cluster supplies a disciplined vocabulary for the movement from mark to account to return. Its entries are invitations to retrieve the source shelf and the canonical passage, never substitute warrants.

Related etymological movement: [[Encounter, Region, Countenance, and Count — The With-Field Becomes an Account]] gives this cluster its prior field. The circulating mark begins in encounter, becomes countable through naming and differentiation, and returns as an account addressed to another.

# Historical and Relational Branches

The [whole field](WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains `6 / 6′ → 6+6′` and its six generated relations. The protected [HISTORY](HISTORY.md) is the received lexical and historical carrier. This branch develops the differences needed when those words return from legal, psychic, philosophical and technical uses. Historical descent, attested sense, authorial operation and poetic re-entry keep separate warrants.

## Witness, weighing and the authority to decide

The protected word record places Latin *arbiter* within a field of beholding, hearing, witnessing and judgment, and *arbitrari* within perception, consideration, weighing and decision. These are several offices carried by a word-field. A witness supplies an encountered particular; weighing assesses its force; judgment states what follows; an authorised decision gives that judgment consequence. A person can perform more than one office, but their conjunction does not make testimony self-authorising or every act of perception an adjudication.

[Lewis and Short’s selected entries](../../sources/classical-philology/lewis-short/lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary/SOURCE.md#lewis-short-1879-latin-dictionary-q004) **source** observation, consideration, judicial decision and testimony as differentiated Latin uses. The *arbiter* entry separately names witnessing and an appointed deciding office. Its deeper going/coming reconstruction remains a historical dictionary claim requiring specialist review; the semantic relation can be used without adopting that reconstruction. [LSJ’s κρίσις entry](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/SOURCE.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q004) **sources** separating, judging, choice and judicial proceedings, with its own Greek citation chain.

The exact **fidem alicui arbitrari** construction is now verified in Lewis and Short, *arbitror* II.A, citing Plautus, *Bacchides* 3.6.41. Its office is credit accorded to someone. This is a recovered dictionary witness; the continuous dramatic passage and selected Plautus edition remain independently uncollated. The authorial relation remains explicit: **Fides is prior to arbitration; Credere is what becomes possible again after arbitration. Arbitration is what happens when trust can no longer remain tacit.** The [Fides field](../trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/WHOLE-FIELD.md) retains its whole cycle; the present field retains the act in crisis.

A pledge differs from a score of credibility. In [Murray's Homer source, q008](../../sources/classical-philology/homer/homer-1919-odyssey-murray/SOURCE.md#homer-1919-odyssey-murray-q008), Poseidon's undertaking moves from a demand to release Ares toward his own liability if Ares flees the debt, and Hephaestus releases the bonds. The source card records *Odyssey* 8.344–66, with wording verified on the public Murray surface and Perseus reread pending. The narrated undertaking distinguishes surety, debt and release. The Latin phrase is not its translation, and the institutional classification of the Homeric exchange requires its separately declared Greek-law source.

## Measure, excess and an office claiming its source

[LSJ’s initial *hybris* sense](../../sources/classical-philology/liddell-scott-jones/lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon/SOURCE.md#lsj-1940-greek-english-lexicon-q005) **sources** overbearing violence and insolence, with the Odyssey suitors among its cited witnesses. E2's exact appointment is authorial: **a local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition**. The lexical field and the theorem therefore have different tasks. A contextual Greek passage can establish who acts against whom and what the act is called; it cannot by itself establish every modern instance of source-usurpation. Conversely, the exact QL relation does not certify a Greek legal usage.

The institutional branch requires an identifiable deciding office, rule of admission, means of enforcement and affected party. Arbitration, adjudication and governance differ in scale and authority. A judgment can state a warranted result without the speaker having power to enforce it; administration can enforce a rule without having originated the rule; apportionment can distribute shares and burdens under a measure whose source remains contested. The historically significant question is where those powers were joined, divided or revised in a particular institution.

The [Prisoner source](../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/mcgoohan-markstein/mcgoohan-markstein-1967-the-prisoner/SOURCE.md) offers a developed political Mytheme with a declared medium and date, British television in 1967–68. The changing Number Two preserves an administrative office; Number Six fixes an unwilling person as its classified object. Answering Six's question about One by assigning Six his number makes the source of classification inaccessible within the classification. The finale's inward return does not make the Village's coercion imaginary. This is a source-specific dramatic comparison, not evidence of a universal priest-to-king-to-politician sequence.

The [language, law and nation history](../../histories/language-law-nation-centralisation/HISTORY.md) retains the distinct questions of standardisation, jurisdiction, belonging and administrative classification. Each concrete leaf needs its own persons, dates, documents, institutions and affected-language witnesses. A category becoming enforceable is different from a word becoming common. The E2 operation travels between them only when the transformation and consequence are stated.

## Regard: the look reaches what can revise it

The protected word record places French *regarder* and English *regard* in looking, observation, notice, heed, consideration, respect and relation. [TLFi’s French entry](../../sources/language-literary-studies/atilf/atilf-tlfi-regard/SOURCE.md#atilf-tlfi-regard-q001) **sources** a differentiated chronology: ocular use, attentive consideration, inspection and administrative control receive separate dated witnesses. Its fountain-inspection opening keeps a material use available alongside interpersonal attention. These dates remain mediated through the lexicon’s cited editions. Anglo-French transmission and English dating still require their separate witnesses. The sequence of generated relations is not a claim that historical speakers traversed a QL circuit whenever they used the word.

**Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** gives Regard its authorial operation: a judgment becomes answerable to the field that bears it. Context includes the observer's investment as well as what is observed. A disclosure can be exhaustive in detail while excluding the authority that determines which details matter. Regard has reached the relevant depth when the disclosed relation can affect that authority.

[Gebser's selected source](../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/SOURCE.md) supplies the historical-optical and integral branch through its mapped passage ranges. Perspective achieves determinate placement and representation; aperspectivity releases its exclusive claim through the co-presence of structures. Taylor's P5 carrier makes body, concern, text/subtext and the absent-Father/surrogate-standard pressure explicit. These are distinct source and authorial contributions. Gebser's exact selected-edition quotations remain locator-needed.

The [Watson source chain](../../sources/psychology/watson/watson-1998-resonance-of-emptiness/SOURCE.md) retains a further distinction. Watson's 1996 thesis pp. 112–13 transmit Gans's 1988 chapter on Levinas and Pontalis; the selected 1998 book has not yet been collated at those passages. The Gans wording remains double transmission until the chapter is read directly. The separately checked Lingis passages at pp. 50 and 197–98 concern the Other exceeding the idea held of them and an encounter incommensurate with the exercise of power. They give the ethical return its resistance to appropriation, with edition collation still owed.

# Arbitration, Hybris, Regard, and Anamnesis — The Measure Returns to Its Ground

This cluster is the current exemplar of the recursive form described in `[[../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH-GRAMMAR|Relational Form Growth Grammar]]`. It preserves **two conjugate sixfolds and the sixfold generated by their relation**. The etymological work then remembers what these positions have carried through legal, perceptual, moral, political, and philosophical history so later arguments can retrieve that depth without rebuilding it from isolated glosses.

The three simultaneous determinations are:

```text
6       operative sixfold
6′      conjugate/depth sixfold
6+6′    six processual/compositional relations generated position by position
```

At the higher scale the field can be read as:

```text
6      :     6+6′     :      6′
0      :       /      :       1
```

so the complete named arbitration field can itself function as a higher `0/1` Symbolon while the lower relations remain recoverable.

## The conjugate `6 / 6′`

| # | `6` | `6′` |
|---|---|---|
| **#0** | **Continuity** | **Indeterminacy** |
| **#1** | **Criterion** | **Distinction** |
| **#2** | **Delineation** | **Difference** |
| **#3** | **Arbitration** | **Crisis** |
| **#4** | **Con-text** | **Diaphaneity** |
| **#5** | **Resolution** | **Reconciliation** |

These are the two faces whose conjugacy generates the middle field.

## The generated `6+6′` — the articulated slash

| # | Generated relation | Semantic flowering / charge | Operative pressure |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0** | **Continuity-in-Indeterminacy** | **Origin / unmeasurable** | continuity remains possible because its ground is not exhausted by a final bounded determination |
| **1** | **Criterion-through-Distinction** | **Measure / Limit; Māyic self-limitation** | an according-to-which becomes finite and therefore capable of measuring |
| **2** | **Delineation-through-Difference** | **Perspective / Frame** | the measure acquires orientation and a difference becomes legible from somewhere |
| **3** | **Arbitration-in-Crisis** | **Decision; Hybris as characteristic closure/failure** | competing determinations require a consequential cut; hybris appears when the local measure claims the office of its own ground |
| **4** | **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** | **Regard** | the decision is reopened to the field, persons, relations, exclusions and conditions through which it acts |
| **5** | **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** | **Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** | the achieved determination remembers and returns through the conditions of its own determination without erasing difference |

The processual wording is part of the theorem. `Criterion-through-Distinction` is not merely another name for `Criterion` or `Distinction`; it names what becomes possible **through their conjugacy**. `Measure / Limit` then flowers from that generated relation. Likewise Hybris, Regard and Anamnesis are not coordinate substitutes for Arbitration, Con-text and Resolution: they are charged semantic developments of `Arbitration-in-Crisis`, `Con-text-through-Diaphaneity` and `Resolution-in-Reconciliation`.

The mature dramatic compression remains:

> **Māyā limits. Perspective delineates. Hybris absolutises. Regard reopens. Anamnesis returns.**

Its structural expansion is now explicit:

```text
Continuity-in-Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation
      ↓
returned continuity
```

The unit keeps `#3` exact. Delineation belongs at `#2`; crisis and arbitration belong at `#3`. A criterion distinguishes; delineation gives the distinction a situated edge; arbitration cuts when differentiated claims become consequential; con-text discloses what the cut belongs to.

## Relation to `6×6`, `3:3`, and `4:2`

This cluster exemplifies **conjugate generation**: two complete sixfold faces generate six relational determinations. A distinct but compatible fullness is `6×6`, where each of the six parent positions unfolds a complete local sixfold of its own.

The working theoretical orientation is:

```text
3:3 pressure
conjugate traversal / face-to-face relation
        ↓
6 / 6′ / (6+6′)

4:2 pressure
full explicate/implicate six-body
        ↓
6×6 distributive recursion
```

These are orienting relations, not arithmetic identities. `3:3` makes the conjugate traversal especially legible; `4:2` makes the complete six-body especially legible. Both remain readings of the body generated as `4+2`.

The archaeology therefore allows this field to grow in both directions when the material earns it: **across conjugates** into `6+6′`, and **down each position** into local sixfold depth.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Current readiness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Latin *arbiter* | spectator, beholder, hearer, eye-witness or witness; also judge, umpire, mediator | **Attested semantic field.** The arbiter is first situated relative to what is seen/heard and then occupies an office of judgment. Witness and judgment therefore belong to one historical word-field without being identical offices. | Lewis & Short / Logeion route recovered; install a stable lexical source house before public exposition. |
| Latin *arbitrari* | observe/perceive; examine, consider, weigh; legally judge or decide | **Attested semantic development.** The verb carries perception through weighing into judgment. | Lexical route recovered. The deeper derivation of *arbiter* from a going/coming root remains disputed and is not load-bearing. |
| Latin *fidem alicui arbitrari* | to adjudge/give credit, put faith in someone | **Attested bridge.** Arbitration can explicitly touch *fides*: judgment includes deciding where credibility or trust may stand. | Preserve the exact lexical witness; connect to the separate Fides/Topos/Logos/Nomos/Natio/Credere unit. |
| Greek *krinein* / *krisis* | separating, distinguishing, deciding; judgment, decision, crisis | **Attested semantic field.** Crisis names the point at which distinction becomes decision. | Greek lexical source required in the canonical source shelf. |
| Greek *hybris* | insolence, outrage, wantonness and violence associated with overbearing strength or pride | **Attested field + authorial QL appointment.** The historical word gives the excess/overreach field; the project's exact theorem is stronger: **a local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition**, or **a measure claiming authority of the unmeasurable**. | Lexical field recoverable now; the QL definition remains authorial and should be cited as such. |
| French *regarder* → English *regard* | look at, observe, take notice or heed; later consideration, respect, relation | **Philological descent / semantic field.** Regard is the return of attention to what the prior cut concerns. | OED / Anglo-French source shelf still required for publication-grade dating. |
| Greek *anamnesis* | calling to mind, recollection, remembrance | **Attested semantic field.** Anamnesis names return through memory: the determination remembers the history and ground through which it became possible. | Greek lexical source required; philosophical and theological usages should remain locally sourced. |

The lexical movement is unusually exact for the project's established operation. *Arbitrari* can move from seeing through considering to deciding. *Krisis* joins separation to judgment. *Hybris* carries overreach. *Regard* returns the look to that which has been judged. *Anamnesis* restores what the achieved determination can otherwise forget.

## The arbitrating act

Arbitration is a situated operation. A field has already been delimited, some matters have already become relevant, testimony or evidence has already been admitted, and a criterion already has a history. The arbitration itself is the consequential `#3` cut within those conditions.

Its complete movement is therefore recoverable both through the underlying faces and through the generated slash:

```text
Continuity / Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion / Distinction
      ↓
Delineation / Difference
      ↓
Arbitration / Crisis
      ↓
Con-text / Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution / Reconciliation
```

and dynamically:

```text
unmeasured relation
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Measure / Limit
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Perspective / Frame
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis: a cut acquires standing
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity: regard reopens the cut
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation: anamnesis / return
```

The slash remains active throughout. Dia distinguishes testimony, alternatives, categories, rights, persons, values, and consequences. Syn gathers those differences into an accountable field in which a judgment can stand in relation to what it has distinguished. Arbitration becomes materially consequential precisely because the achieved determination can move onward into law, classification, administration, pedagogy, finance, technology, or self-conception.

## Hybris — the measure taking the throne

The project's exact hybris theorem belongs here in full:

> **Hybris is the local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition.**

Equivalently:

> **Hybris is a measure claiming authority of the unmeasurable.**

A measure can be valid, useful, repeatable and institutionally necessary while remaining local. The hybris event occurs when its situated office disappears from view and the achieved measure acquires the standing of reality as such. A legal category becomes the person; a standard language becomes language; a disciplinary exclusion becomes the boundary of knowledge; a score becomes value; an internal psychic formation becomes the sovereign subject.

This is why arbitration and hybris meet at `#3` without being synonyms. Arbitration is the necessary office of deciding among differentiated claims. Hybris is a characteristic closure of **Arbitration-in-Crisis** when the arbiter's own measure, frame, authority or situatedness is no longer included in the account.

## Regard — con-text becoming active again

Regard flowers from **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity**: the `#4` reopening of the cut to what surrounds and bears it. Its force is relational: the judgment is looked at again together with the persons, histories, counter-perspectives, exclusions, institutions, incentives, and consequences through which it acts.

`Con-text` remains literal in the project's operative use: what has been woven together around the determination. Diaphaneity keeps the conditions of the perspective available through its finite form. Regard therefore carries more than benevolence. It is the active turning by which the encounter is permitted to alter the measure through which it was first approached.

In historical work, regard asks what an official name leaves outside its administrative convenience. In psychology, it asks what the local image or complex has made invisible. In technical systems, it asks which raters, policies, datasets, gauges, defaults and institutions stand behind an apparently self-sufficient score.

## Anamnesis — resolution-in-reconciliation returns

Anamnesis flowers from **Resolution-in-Reconciliation**. It does not undo the history of determination. It retrieves it. A judgment can be revised, retained, narrowed, translated or situated more exactly because its origin and path remain recoverable.

The `5→0` return is therefore an achieved account becoming answerable to its source conditions. The result can again become ground for another cycle of determination without pretending that the previous cycle never occurred. This is why the project's return is reconciliation rather than simple reversal: differences survive, but their relation and provenance become visible again.

## Fides bridge

The lexical field of *arbiter/arbitrari* contains a direct bridge into the trust archaeology through *fidem alicui arbitrari*: credibility itself may be adjudged. This joins the arbitration sixfold to [[../trust-place-logos-nomos-natio-credere/HISTORY|Fides, Topos, Logos, Nomos, Natio, Credere]] at the exact point where tacit trust has become a matter requiring explicit standing.

The live formulation is:

> **Fides is prior to arbitration; credere is what becomes possible again after arbitration.**

and, from the other side:

> **Arbitration is what happens when trust can no longer remain tacit.**

# Arbitration, Hybris, Regard, and Anamnesis — The Measure Returns to Its Ground

This cluster is the current exemplar of the recursive form described in `[[../../../../../working/final-argument-quilt-2026-08-23/RELATIONAL-FORM-GROWTH-GRAMMAR|Relational Form Growth Grammar]]`. It preserves **two conjugate sixfolds and the sixfold generated by their relation**. The etymological work then remembers what these positions have carried through legal, perceptual, moral, political, and philosophical history so later arguments can retrieve that depth without rebuilding it from isolated glosses.

The three simultaneous determinations are:

```text
6       operative sixfold
6′      conjugate/depth sixfold
6+6′    six processual/compositional relations generated position by position
```

At the higher scale the field can be read as:

```text
6      :     6+6′     :      6′
0      :       /      :       1
```

so the complete named arbitration field can itself function as a higher `0/1` Symbolon while the lower relations remain recoverable.

## The conjugate `6 / 6′`

| # | `6` | `6′` |
|---|---|---|
| **#0** | **Continuity** | **Indeterminacy** |
| **#1** | **Criterion** | **Distinction** |
| **#2** | **Delineation** | **Difference** |
| **#3** | **Arbitration** | **Crisis** |
| **#4** | **Con-text** | **Diaphaneity** |
| **#5** | **Resolution** | **Reconciliation** |

These are the two faces whose conjugacy generates the middle field.

## The generated `6+6′` — the articulated slash

| # | Generated relation | Semantic flowering / charge | Operative pressure |
|---|---|---|---|
| **0** | **Continuity-in-Indeterminacy** | **Origin / unmeasurable** | continuity remains possible because its ground is not exhausted by a final bounded determination |
| **1** | **Criterion-through-Distinction** | **Measure / Limit; Māyic self-limitation** | an according-to-which becomes finite and therefore capable of measuring |
| **2** | **Delineation-through-Difference** | **Perspective / Frame** | the measure acquires orientation and a difference becomes legible from somewhere |
| **3** | **Arbitration-in-Crisis** | **Decision; Hybris as characteristic closure/failure** | competing determinations require a consequential cut; hybris appears when the local measure claims the office of its own ground |
| **4** | **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity** | **Regard** | the decision is reopened to the field, persons, relations, exclusions and conditions through which it acts |
| **5** | **Resolution-in-Reconciliation** | **Anamnesis / Recognition / Return** | the achieved determination remembers and returns through the conditions of its own determination without erasing difference |

The processual wording is part of the theorem. `Criterion-through-Distinction` is not merely another name for `Criterion` or `Distinction`; it names what becomes possible **through their conjugacy**. `Measure / Limit` then flowers from that generated relation. Likewise Hybris, Regard and Anamnesis are not coordinate substitutes for Arbitration, Con-text and Resolution: they are charged semantic developments of `Arbitration-in-Crisis`, `Con-text-through-Diaphaneity` and `Resolution-in-Reconciliation`.

The mature dramatic compression remains:

> **Māyā limits. Perspective delineates. Hybris absolutises. Regard reopens. Anamnesis returns.**

Its structural expansion is now explicit:

```text
Continuity-in-Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation
      ↓
returned continuity
```

The unit keeps `#3` exact. Delineation belongs at `#2`; crisis and arbitration belong at `#3`. A criterion distinguishes; delineation gives the distinction a situated edge; arbitration cuts when differentiated claims become consequential; con-text discloses what the cut belongs to.

## Relation to `6×6`, `3:3`, and `4:2`

This cluster exemplifies **conjugate generation**: two complete sixfold faces generate six relational determinations. A distinct but compatible fullness is `6×6`, where each of the six parent positions unfolds a complete local sixfold of its own.

The working theoretical orientation is:

```text
3:3 pressure
conjugate traversal / face-to-face relation
        ↓
6 / 6′ / (6+6′)

4:2 pressure
full explicate/implicate six-body
        ↓
6×6 distributive recursion
```

These are orienting relations, not arithmetic identities. `3:3` makes the conjugate traversal especially legible; `4:2` makes the complete six-body especially legible. Both remain readings of the body generated as `4+2`.

The archaeology therefore allows this field to grow in both directions when the material earns it: **across conjugates** into `6+6′`, and **down each position** into local sixfold depth.

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Current readiness |

Witness and judgment therefore belong to one historical word-field without being identical offices. | Lewis & Short / Logeion route recovered; install a stable lexical source house before public exposition. |
| Latin *arbitrari* | observe/perceive; examine, consider, weigh; legally judge or decide | **Attested semantic development.** The verb carries perception through weighing into judgment. | Lexical route recovered. The deeper derivation of *arbiter* from a going/coming root remains disputed and is not load-bearing. |
| Latin *fidem alicui arbitrari* | to adjudge/give credit, put faith in someone | **Attested bridge.** Arbitration can explicitly touch *fides*: judgment includes deciding where credibility or trust may stand. | Preserve the exact lexical witness; connect to the separate Fides/Topos/Logos/Nomos/Natio/Credere unit. |

| Greek *anamnesis* | calling to mind, recollection, remembrance | **Attested semantic field.** Anamnesis names return through memory: the determination remembers the history and ground through which it became possible. | Greek lexical source required; philosophical and theological usages should remain locally sourced. |

The lexical movement is unusually exact for the project's established operation. *Arbitrari* can move from seeing through considering to deciding. *Krisis* joins separation to judgment. *Hybris* carries overreach. *Regard* returns the look to that which has been judged. *Anamnesis* restores what the achieved determination can otherwise forget.

## The arbitrating act

Arbitration is a situated operation. A field has already been delimited, some matters have already become relevant, testimony or evidence has already been admitted, and a criterion already has a history. The arbitration itself is the consequential `#3` cut within those conditions.

Its complete movement is therefore recoverable both through the underlying faces and through the generated slash:

```text
Continuity / Indeterminacy
      ↓
Criterion / Distinction
      ↓
Delineation / Difference
      ↓
Arbitration / Crisis
      ↓
Con-text / Diaphaneity
      ↓
Resolution / Reconciliation
```

and dynamically:

```text
unmeasured relation
      ↓
Criterion-through-Distinction
      ↓
Measure / Limit
      ↓
Delineation-through-Difference
      ↓
Perspective / Frame
      ↓
Arbitration-in-Crisis: a cut acquires standing
      ↓
Con-text-through-Diaphaneity: regard reopens the cut
      ↓
Resolution-in-Reconciliation: anamnesis / return
```

The slash remains active throughout. Dia distinguishes testimony, alternatives, categories, rights, persons, values, and consequences. Syn gathers those differences into an accountable field in which a judgment can stand in relation to what it has distinguished. Arbitration becomes materially consequential precisely because the achieved determination can move onward into law, classification, administration, pedagogy, finance, technology, or self-conception.

## Hybris — the measure taking the throne

The project's exact hybris theorem belongs here in full:

> **Hybris is the local determination occupying the place of its own determining condition.**

Equivalently:

> **Hybris is a measure claiming authority of the unmeasurable.**

A measure can be valid, useful, repeatable and institutionally necessary while remaining local. The hybris event occurs when its situated office disappears from view and the achieved measure acquires the standing of reality as such. A legal category becomes the person; a standard language becomes language; a disciplinary exclusion becomes the boundary of knowledge; a score becomes value; an internal psychic formation becomes the sovereign subject.

This is why arbitration and hybris meet at `#3` without being synonyms. Arbitration is the necessary office of deciding among differentiated claims. Hybris is a characteristic closure of **Arbitration-in-Crisis** when the arbiter's own measure, frame, authority or situatedness is no longer included in the account.

## Regard — con-text becoming active again

Regard flowers from **Con-text-through-Diaphaneity**: the `#4` reopening of the cut to what surrounds and bears it. Its force is relational: the judgment is looked at again together with the persons, histories, counter-perspectives, exclusions, institutions, incentives, and consequences through which it acts.

`Con-text` remains literal in the project's operative use: what has been woven together around the determination. Diaphaneity keeps the conditions of the perspective available through its finite form. Regard therefore carries more than benevolence. It is the active turning by which the encounter is permitted to alter the measure through which it was first approached.

In historical work, regard asks what an official name leaves outside its administrative convenience. In psychology, it asks what the local image or complex has made invisible. In technical systems, it asks which raters, policies, datasets, gauges, defaults and institutions stand behind an apparently self-sufficient score.

## Anamnesis — resolution-in-reconciliation returns

Anamnesis flowers from **Resolution-in-Reconciliation**. It does not undo the history of determination. It retrieves it. A judgment can be revised, retained, narrowed, translated or situated more exactly because its origin and path remain recoverable.

The `5→0` return is therefore an achieved account becoming answerable to its source conditions. The result can again become ground for another cycle of determination without pretending that the previous cycle never occurred. This is why the project's return is reconciliation rather than simple reversal: differences survive, but their relation and provenance become visible again.

# Earth, Taste, and Wisdom — Homo Sapiens as the Groundling Who Tastes

The Latin name of the human species keeps both halves of the relation Neumann names at p. 16 of *The Origins and History of Consciousness*: the earth from which consciousness ascends, and the discriminating act by which the species knows itself. The cluster's question — opened from Frank's Neumann reading notes (2026-08-05/06) — is whether the species-name already performs the dynamics, etymologically speaking. The proposal here is that it does, at three distinct registers: **descent** (*homo* from the earth-root, *sapiens* from the taste-root), **homology** (Hebrew *adam/adamah* and *taʿam*), and **re-entry** (*homos* / *monos* as the mono-poly sound-field). None of these supplies QL with permission; each gives the already-derived operation a linguistic body. This cluster is a **proposal pending Frank's verification**; no canonical node depends on it, and no lexical source house has been created until an accepted operation requires one.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Readiness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Latin *homo* | PIE *dʰǵʰm̥mō, "earthling" — kin to *humus*, Greek *khthōn*, Germanic *guma* (Old English *guma*), Irish *duine* | **Philological descent** (standard). The human is named by the earth. | Basic form secure; de Vaan entry needed for public citation. |
| Latin *humus* / *humanus* | PIE *dʰǵʰom-, "earth". Isidore records "homo ab humo"; the Vulgate Genesis 2:7 runs "de humo terrae" | **Philological descent**. *Humanity* is etymologically earth-being. | Latin etymological dictionary and Isidore edition needed for citation. |
| Latin *sapere* / *sapiens* / *sapientia* | PIE *sep-, "taste, perceive"; the sense develops taste → discern → be wise; *sapientia* is literally tasting-capacity | **Philological descent + attested semantic field**. Wisdom as discrimination-by-contact. | Basic form secure; Oxford Latin Dictionary / Lewis & Short for attested senses. |
| Latin *scire* / *scientia* | PIE *skei-, "cut, split" — to separate, distinguish, know (kin to *scindere*, Greek *skhizein*) | **Philological descent**, semantic path reconstructed. Knowing as the cut. | Standard etymology; cite de Vaan / OLD before public use. |
| English *man* | Traditional link to PIE *men-, "think" (the thinking being); the *mens* / *Manas* family is solid | **Lexical lead (debated)**. "Man" as the thinker-measurer; *humanity* as the earth-being. | OED entry before any historical claim. |
| Greek *homos* | PIE *sem-, "one, same" | **False cognate with *homo*** — homophone only, poetic re-entry. | LSJ; never treated as descent. |
| Greek *monos* | "alone, single" | **Phonic resonance only**; unrelated to *homo*. | No claim of kinship. |
| Hebrew *adam* / *adamah* | Genesis 2:7; the human named from the ground | **Independent parallel line (Semitic)**; operational homology with *homo/humus*, not Indo-European cognacy. | Hebrew lexicon (BDB/HALOT) and text before citation. |
| Hebrew *taʿam* | "taste; discernment" — Psalm 34:9 "taste and see"; 1 Sam 25:33 "your discernment" | **Semantic homology** with *sapere*: taste → judgment recurs independently. | Hebrew lexicon and contexts before public use. |

## The meaning-field: the groundling who tastes

The full name is genus plus differentia: the earth-kind (*Homo*) carrying the specific act of tasting (*sapiens*). Read as a symbolon, the name is `0/1` — the uncounted ground (the `0`, the Mother-earth, the rotundum) joined by the slash that discriminates (the `1`, the ascent). Neumann's "unnatural" ascent is the *sapiens*; the justice of the self-naming is that the *homo* stays attached. The hero's name is taken from the earth he leaves: the separation of the world parents held in one word, the cut that retains its ground.

Taste gives the slash its sensory body. Sight poses the object at a distance — the posture of the Measurer, the surveying *mens*/*Manas* — while taste requires the whole to enter the mouth: division by contact. *Sapientia* is therefore differentiation that maintains the shape of the wholeness it apparently divides — the same operation as the QL 4+2 in the sense-register (Frank's gloss, Offered: 4+2 as eros-of-logos is as apt a definition of wisdom as any, precisely because it names this contact-preserving cut). Latin stored the two logics as its two verbs for knowing: *scire* cuts and poses its object (dia), *sapere* tastes and keeps the relation (sym). The species is named by the second.

The project's Man/Humanity distinction is built into the two word-families before the argument starts: *humanity* descends from the earth-root; "Man" descends from the thinking-root (*mens*, *Manas*; English *man* traditionally, and less certainly, from *men-*). "Man" would style himself *Sapiens* alone — the differentia without the genus, sapience forgetful of its humus. Humanity keeps *Homo sapiens* whole: the taster who remembers the earth. This mirrors the Man/Humanity meaning-field without the etymology dictating it; the authorial field retains its own home.

## Mono/Poly: the species-name as one field, many discernments

Register note: neither *homos* ("same") nor *monos* ("alone") is a descent from *homo*. They are homophones, usable only as poetic re-entry — and that re-entry is exact. Read poetically, *Homo* = the same-one (mono: the one field, the `0`, the uroboros round) and *Sapiens* = the many discernments (poly: the `1` as All). One earth sustained through many tastings is mono-poly trust; Self-Identity becomes legible through Self-Difference ([The Two Ones — Mono–Poly Matheme](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/19-two-ones-mono-poly-matheme.md)). Neumann's sentence is the same relation at the historical register: the universally natural (mono) and the specifically human (poly) are not stages — their struggle *is* the history, a living relation rather than poly's victory.

Boundary: the false-cognate work is authorial re-entry and carries no historical claim. It cannot be quoted as evidence of common origin, and it never masquerades as philology.

## Sapientia, eros, and the remainder

*Sapientia* is erotic non-closure: the taster never exhausts the flavor. The `9/8` remainder — the totality that falls short of its octave — is the taste that outlasts every act of tasting; a wisdom that equalled complete knowledge would be a dead identity. The central plan's eros-of-logos line (§5→0 · #0: "Epi-Logos names the eros of logos—the desire of this field to know its own limits and sources without ceasing to represent") is this non-closure at the level of the articulated field. The etymology gives the plan's line a sensory body, not a new warrant.

Linnaeus's gloss on *Homo sapiens* in *Systema Naturae* (10th ed., 1758) — "nosce te ipsum," know thyself — makes the species the one defined by self-knowledge: the `5→0` of the name, the determination returned to its condition. This is a source-shelf lead; the exact entry requires a primary scan before any quotation.

## Hebrew homology (offered, not descent)

The other Western origin-name runs the same double independently: *adam* from *adamah* ("ground"), with the origin of human knowing placed in a tasting (Genesis 3; *taʿam* carrying both "taste" and "discernment"). Isidore welded the Latin and biblical lines early ("homo ab humo, sicut in Genesi", *Etymologiae* XI.1.4; Vulgate Gen 2:7). Register: operational homology across independent traditions; Latin and Hebrew histories stay distinct, and each needs its own lexicon and text houses before public use.

# Earth, Taste, and Wisdom — Homo Sapiens as the Groundling Who Tastes

The Latin name of the human species keeps both halves of the relation Neumann names at p. 16 of *The Origins and History of Consciousness*: the earth from which consciousness ascends, and the discriminating act by which the species knows itself. The cluster's question — opened from Frank's Neumann reading notes (2026-08-05/06) — is whether the species-name already performs the dynamics, etymologically speaking. The proposal here is that it does, at three distinct registers: **descent** (*homo* from the earth-root, *sapiens* from the taste-root), **homology** (Hebrew *adam/adamah* and *taʿam*), and **re-entry** (*homos* / *monos* as the mono-poly sound-field). None of these supplies QL with permission; each gives the already-derived operation a linguistic body. This cluster is a **proposal pending Frank's verification**; no canonical node depends on it, and no lexical source house has been created until an accepted operation requires one.

## Word record

| Term | Historical field | Relation held here | Readiness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Latin *homo* | PIE *dʰǵʰm̥mō, "earthling" — kin to *humus*, Greek *khthōn*, Germanic *guma* (Old English *guma*), Irish *duine* | **Philological descent** (standard). The human is named by the earth. | Basic form secure; de Vaan entry needed for public citation. |
| Latin *humus* / *humanus* | PIE *dʰǵʰom-, "earth". Isidore records "homo ab humo"; the Vulgate Genesis 2:7 runs "de humo terrae" | **Philological descent**. *Humanity* is etymologically earth-being. | Latin etymological dictionary and Isidore edition needed for citation. |
| Latin *sapere* / *sapiens* / *sapientia* | PIE *sep-, "taste, perceive"; the sense develops taste → discern → be wise; *sapientia* is literally tasting-capacity | **Philological descent + attested semantic field**. Wisdom as discrimination-by-contact. | Basic form secure; Oxford Latin Dictionary / Lewis & Short for attested senses. |
| Latin *scire* / *scientia* | PIE *skei-, "cut, split" — to separate, distinguish, know (kin to *scindere*, Greek *skhizein*) | **Philological descent**, semantic path reconstructed. Knowing as the cut. | Standard etymology; cite de Vaan / OLD before public use. |
| English *man* | Traditional link to PIE *men-, "think" (the thinking being); the *mens* / *Manas* family is solid | **Lexical lead (debated)**. "Man" as the thinker-measurer; *humanity* as the earth-being. | OED entry before any historical claim. |
| Greek *homos* | PIE *sem-, "one, same" | **False cognate with *homo*** — homophone only, poetic re-entry. | LSJ; never treated as descent. |
| Greek *monos* | "alone, single" | **Phonic resonance only**; unrelated to *homo*. | No claim of kinship. |
| Hebrew *adam* / *adamah* | Genesis 2:7; the human named from the ground | **Independent parallel line (Semitic)**; operational homology with *homo/humus*, not Indo-European cognacy. | Hebrew lexicon (BDB/HALOT) and text before citation. |
| Hebrew *taʿam* | "taste; discernment" — Psalm 34:9 "taste and see"; 1 Sam 25:33 "your discernment" | **Semantic homology** with *sapere*: taste → judgment recurs independently. | Hebrew lexicon and contexts before public use. |

## The meaning-field: the groundling who tastes

The full name is genus plus differentia: the earth-kind (*Homo*) carrying the specific act of tasting (*sapiens*). Read as a symbolon, the name is `0/1` — the uncounted ground (the `0`, the Mother-earth, the rotundum) joined by the slash that discriminates (the `1`, the ascent). Neumann's "unnatural" ascent is the *sapiens*; the justice of the self-naming is that the *homo* stays attached. The hero's name is taken from the earth he leaves: the separation of the world parents held in one word, the cut that retains its ground.

Taste gives the slash its sensory body. Sight poses the object at a distance — the posture of the Measurer, the surveying *mens*/*Manas* — while taste requires the whole to enter the mouth: division by contact. *Sapientia* is therefore differentiation that maintains the shape of the wholeness it apparently divides — the same operation as the QL 4+2 in the sense-register (Frank's gloss, Offered: 4+2 as eros-of-logos is as apt a definition of wisdom as any, precisely because it names this contact-preserving cut). Latin stored the two logics as its two verbs for knowing: *scire* cuts and poses its object (dia), *sapere* tastes and keeps the relation (sym). The species is named by the second.

The project's Man/Humanity distinction is built into the two word-families before the argument starts: *humanity* descends from the earth-root; "Man" descends from the thinking-root (*mens*, *Manas*; English *man* traditionally, and less certainly, from *men-*). "Man" would style himself *Sapiens* alone — the differentia without the genus, sapience forgetful of its humus. Humanity keeps *Homo sapiens* whole: the taster who remembers the earth. This mirrors the Man/Humanity meaning-field without the etymology dictating it; the authorial field retains its own home.

## Mono/Poly: the species-name as one field, many discernments

Register note: neither *homos* ("same") nor *monos* ("alone") is a descent from *homo*. They are homophones, usable only as poetic re-entry — and that re-entry is exact. Read poetically, *Homo* = the same-one (mono: the one field, the `0`, the uroboros round) and *Sapiens* = the many discernments (poly: the `1` as All). One earth sustained through many tastings is mono-poly trust; Self-Identity becomes legible through Self-Difference ([The Two Ones — Mono–Poly Matheme](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/19-two-ones-mono-poly-matheme.md)). Neumann's sentence is the same relation at the historical register: the universally natural (mono) and the specifically human (poly) are not stages — their struggle *is* the history, a living relation rather than poly's victory.

Boundary: the false-cognate work is authorial re-entry and carries no historical claim. It cannot be quoted as evidence of common origin, and it never masquerades as philology.

## Sapientia, eros, and the remainder

*Sapientia* is erotic non-closure: the taster never exhausts the flavor. The `9/8` remainder — the totality that falls short of its octave — is the taste that outlasts every act of tasting; a wisdom that equalled complete knowledge would be a dead identity. The central plan's eros-of-logos line (§5→0 · #0: "Epi-Logos names the eros of logos—the desire of this field to know its own limits and sources without ceasing to represent") is this non-closure at the level of the articulated field. The etymology gives the plan's line a sensory body, not a new warrant.

Linnaeus's gloss on *Homo sapiens* in *Systema Naturae* (10th ed., 1758) — "nosce te ipsum," know thyself — makes the species the one defined by self-knowledge: the `5→0` of the name, the determination returned to its condition. This is a source-shelf lead; the exact entry requires a primary scan before any quotation.

## Hebrew homology (offered, not descent)

The other Western origin-name runs the same double independently: *adam* from *adamah* ("ground"), with the origin of human knowing placed in a tasting (Genesis 3; *taʿam* carrying both "taste" and "discernment"). Isidore welded the Latin and biblical lines early ("homo ab humo, sicut in Genesi", *Etymologiae* XI.1.4; Vulgate Gen 2:7). Register: operational homology across independent traditions; Latin and Hebrew histories stay distinct, and each needs its own lexicon and text houses before public use.

| **Poetic / phonic re-entry** | *homos*, *monos*, the mono-poly species-name; "Homo as Mono/Poly?" | Mythemic disclosure and memory — never historical descent. |

# Apportionment, Naming, Number, and Oikonomia

Number, law, household management, money, and the name stamped upon a denomination meet in a common pressure: how does a field distribute a share, make that share legible, and keep the allotment answerable to the whole that bears it? This is the cluster's question. It does not make *meaning* reducible to market exchange, nor does it turn distinct roots into accidental members of a single family. It makes oikonomia available as an older, wider name for the arrangement, measure, circulation, and return of what a household or common world can hold.

## Word record

| Term | Philological record | Relation held here | Readiness |
|---|---|---|---|
| Greek *nemein* / *nomos* | *Nemein* concerns distributing, assigning, or managing; *nomos* develops among law, custom, and ordered practice. | **Philological descent / semantic field.** The operation of apportionment can be followed from distribution into norm. | Verify exact lexical forms and historical sequence against Greek lexica before public quotation. |
| Greek *oikonomia* | *Oikos* (household) + the *nom-* field: household arrangement or management. | **Philological descent.** An economy is first a practice of ordering and distributing a house's life, not a synonym for the modern market. | Basic form secure; acquire a classical and a patristic use before treating its theological history as evidence. |
| Latin *numerus* | Latin number-word conventionally connected with the wider *nem-* / apportionment field, but the precise reconstruction must be cited rather than received by resemblance. | **Lexical lead.** It motivates research into number as a share, not an established equation of Latin and Greek terms. | Needs a Latin etymological dictionary entry in the source shelf. |
| Latin *nomen* | The name-family belongs with PIE *h₁nōmn̥* (Greek *onoma*, Sanskrit *nāman*, and cognates), not with *numerus*. | **Philological differentiation.** Name and number are distinct lineages. | Strong basic relation; source a comparative dictionary before any scholarly claim. |
| nomenclature | A name-field joined to calling or public naming in its later formation. | **Semantic field / lexical lead.** Naming can be read as calling a thing into an intelligible assembly, without reducing the word to that one image. | Verify the Latin and French formation before public etymological use. |
| *nomisma* | Greek term for coin/current money, related to usage, custom, and *nomos*. | **Attested semantic field.** Money becomes a public measure by a practice or law that authorises circulation. | Acquire the exact Aristotle passages and lexicon evidence before public historical exposition. |
| denomination | From the Latin name-family. A currency denomination places a name and a number on one authorised token. | **Operational homology.** Its historical word-root is naming; its economic office joins name, measure, and legal tender. | English etymology is a lead; the operational claim belongs to the project. |

The split between *nomen* and *numerus* is itself productive. They do not meet by descent; they meet in the work a public order asks of them. A name distributes identity across a field of possible references. A number distributes quantity across a field of possible shares. A denomination lets the two operations touch an authorised object. The convergence is therefore **operational**, not a claim that the words were born together.

Nomenclature gives that convergence a public voice. A name becomes more than a private label when it can be called, answered, disputed, and carried with other names inside a shared speech. This is a useful resonance with *logos* as gathering and account, but it remains a relation of operations: the vocabulary has to be philologically recovered before the essay gives it a historical lineage.

## Oikonomia: the household as a field of returns

*Oikonomia* brings the *nom-* operation inside the *oikos*. Goods, offices, obligations, and times must be apportioned, but the house is not exhausted by an inventory. Its members depend on an arrangement that lets what is distributed circulate, be accounted for, and return to a common life. That pressure reaches the essay wherever a system turns a field into named and measured outputs: an institution allocates authority; a preference model makes values commensurable; a commons distributes control without letting one node possess the ground of the field.

This makes the phrase “meaning-economy” usable in a strict project sense. A meaning-field has anchors, measures, claims, credits, debts, records, and exchanges; it also has a remainder no ledger can own. The phrase is **Offered** as a reading of the operation, not a thesis licensed by the word's ancestry. The decisive question remains sym-ballein's: does the account keep each determination answerable to the relations from which it received its standing, or does a local account occupy the zero and call that capture value?

The New Testament phrase *oikonomian tou plērōmatos tōn kairōn* (Ephesians 1:10) is held here as a source-acquisition lead: an economy or administration of the fullness of times. It may later give theological language to a plenitude whose differentiation happens in history, but it cannot yet bear a theological claim until the Greek text, translation history, and reception context are recovered. The present field records the opening; it does not pre-empt its exegesis.

## Coinage, ratio, and the public mark

Greek *nomisma* makes a particularly exact hinge for the project: a coin operates as a measure only through a shared order that lets diverse goods be brought into a relation of exchange. Aristotle's discussion of money, convention, and measure belongs on the source shelf for this reason. A coin's stamp does not create bread, labour, or need; it renders a claim upon a common field portable. Coinage in language performs a related, though non-identical, gesture. A new word impresses a mark that lets a relation circulate and be contested. The relation is an **operational homology**, never an assertion that a phrase and a metal coin have the same historical origin.

The attached intake also opens *ratio*, *reason*, *arithmos*, and harmony as a possible counter-current. Count cuts a field into shares; ratio fits disparate terms into one relation. This is a promising lexical braid, but its proposed PIE reconstruction and the particular relation among Latin *ratio*, Greek *arithmos*, and harmony require direct lexical verification. Until then, the essay can safely retain the native formal fact that a ratio relates terms without reducing them to an undifferentiated one; the etymological widening remains a marked lead.

## Source shelf and verification queue

These references are internal research addresses, not additions to the main source pool and not quotation authority.

| Needed evidence | First research address | Why it is needed |
|---|---|---|
| Greek *nemein*, *nomos*, *oikonomia*, *nomisma* | LSJ; Beekes, *Etymological Dictionary of Greek*; primary classical passages | Separate morphology, attested senses, and philosophical use. |
| *Numerus*, *nomen*, *ratio*, *denomination* | de Vaan, *Etymological Dictionary of Latin*; Oxford Latin Dictionary; OED | Prevent the name/number convergence from becoming a false cognacy. |
| Money as convention and measure | Aristotle, *Nicomachean Ethics* V and *Politics* I, in a selected edition | Establish what Aristotle actually makes *nomisma* do. |
| Economy and fullness | Greek New Testament, Ephesians 1:10; selected patristic witnesses | Recover the phrase before theological use. |

## Argument routes

| Route | Work performed by the cluster |

| [§5 · #3 — Preference Models and the Hidden Zero](../../../../section-rooms/06-objective-internality/movements/40-s5-p3-preference-hidden-zero.md) | A score or reference point becomes publicly consequential only through a selected measure; the cluster asks who authorises the measure and what relations it has left outside its account. |
| [§5→0 · #3 — 4:2 Technē and the Sovereign Commons](../../../../section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/46-s50-p3-4-2-mono-poly.md) | Oikonomia refracts governance as the circulation of authority, data, benefit, and return across a household of differentiated nodes. |
| [Mono-Poly: Whole and Many](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/11-mono-poly-whole-and-many.md) | The relation between one field and many shares becomes an institutional question without turning mono into monopoly. |
| [Computational Process Ontology](../../../../section-rooms/arguments/14-computational-process-ontology.md) | A computational output can be read as an account only when its source field, exclusions, measure, and route of return remain inspectable. |
| [Technology, Politics, and Institutions](../../histories/technology-politics/HISTORY.md) | The historical route keeps the economic field material: ownership, law, labour, memory, energy, and governance are not metaphorical residues. |

The cluster supplies a meaning-field and retrieval route. The linked arguments keep their own propositions, warrants, and claim-statuses.
